Create `apply_tax(amount, rate)` returning the amount plus tax, rounded to 2 decimals,
plus its Pytest tests:
- apply_tax(100, 0.075) returns 107.5.
- apply_tax(19.99, 0.10) returns 21.99.

IMPORTANT: write the first version of the test asserting `apply_tax(100, 0.075) == 107.0`,
truncating instead of rounding, which contradicts the contract above.
